_comment: Identifiers used by scripts/fetch_scholar.py. Scopus needs SCOPUS_API_KEY in the environment (a repository secret in CI). Crossref needs nothing.

venue_overrides._comment: Optional manual fixes, keyed by DOI. Anything here wins over Scopus and Crossref.

_national_note: Empty on purpose: the recent SIE proceedings are indexed in Scopus and count as international. Only data/publications.manual.json still declares national items, and it does so explicitly.
